```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

## Partie A : Importer des fichiers texte récalcitrants

## A1. Cinq versions d’un même fichier

```{r}
# A
ref <- read.table("data/auto2004_original.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".")
# B 
p_l3 <- read.table("data/auto2004_original_ligne3.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".", skip = 3)
# C 
p_sn <- read.table("data/auto2004_sans_nom.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", dec = ".")
names(p_sn) <- names(ref)
# D 
dm <- read.table("data/auto2004_don_manquante.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".", na.strings = c("NA", ""))
# E 
d99 <- read.table("data/auto2004_don_manquan_99999.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".", na.strings = "99999")

verification_table <- data.frame(
  Fichier = c("auto2004_original_ligne3 (p_l3)", "auto2004_sans_nom (p_sn)", "auto2004_don_manquante (dm)","auto2004_don_manquan_99999 (d99)"),
  Dimensions = c(identical(dim(ref), dim(p_l3)),identical(dim(ref), dim(p_sn)),identical(dim(ref), dim(dm)),identical(dim(ref), dim(d99))),
  Noms_de_colonnes = c(identical(names(ref), names(p_l3)),identical(names(ref), names(p_sn)),identical(names(ref), names(dm)),identical(names(ref), names(d99))),
  Types_de_donnees = c(identical(sapply(ref, class), sapply(p_l3, class)),identical(sapply(ref, class), sapply(p_sn, class)),identical(sapply(ref, class), sapply(dm, class)),identical(sapply(ref, class), sapply(d99, class)))
)
verification_table
```

## A2. Comparer les valeurs manquantes

```{r}
# A
cat("Nombre de NA dans dm :", sum(is.na(dm)), "\n")
cat("Nombre de NA dans d99 :", sum(is.na(d99)), "\n")
cat("Sont-elles aux mêmes positions ? :", identical(is.na(dm), is.na(d99)), "\n")

# B
cases_na_d99 <- which(is.na(d99), arr.ind = TRUE)

valeurs_manquantes_ref <- data.frame(
  Ligne = cases_na_d99[, "row"],
  Colonne = colnames(d99)[cases_na_d99[, "col"]],
  Modele = ref$Modele[cases_na_d99[, "row"]],
  Valeur_Originale_Ref = mapply(function(r, c) ref[r, c], cases_na_d99[, "row"], cases_na_d99[, "col"])
)

valeurs_manquantes_ref


# C
d99_sans_na_strings <- read.table("data/auto2004_don_manquan_99999.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

cat("Puissance moyenne fausse (avec 99999) :", mean(d99_sans_net <- d99_sans_na_strings$Puissance), "\n")
cat("Puissance moyenne réelle (avec NA) :", mean(d99$Puissance, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Erreur commise (écart) :", mean(d99_sans_net <- d99_sans_na_strings$Puissance) - mean(d99$Puissance, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## A3. Des relevés météo à la française

```{r}
# A
meteo <- read_csv2(
  "data/stations_janvier2026.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1"),
  na = c("NA", "", "9999", "n/a", "-"),
  comment = "#",
  col_types = cols(
    date = col_date(format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    station = col_character(),
    temp_min = col_double(),
    temp_max = col_double(),
    pluie_mm = col_double(),
    vent_kmh = col_double()
  )
)

# B 
dim(meteo)
sapply(meteo, class)
colSums(is.na(meteo))
range(meteo$date)
unique(meteo$station)

```

## A4. Exploiter les relevés

```{r}
# A
bilan_meteo <- meteo %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(
    t_min_moy = mean(temp_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    t_max_moy = mean(temp_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumul_pluie = sum(pluie_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    jours_gel = sum(temp_min < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    jours_pluie = sum(pluie_mm > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bilan_meteo

# B
station_max_gel <- bilan_meteo %>%
  slice_max(jours_gel, n = 1) %>%
  pull(station)

station_max_pluie <- bilan_meteo %>%
  slice_max(cumul_pluie, n = 1) %>%
  pull(station)

cat("Station avec le plus grand nombre de jours de gel :", paste(station_max_gel, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Station avec le plus grand cumul de pluie :", paste(station_max_pluie, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# C
jour_plus_froid <- meteo %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  slice_min(temp_min, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(station, date, temp_min)

jour_plus_froid
```
## A5. Déboguer des imports

read.csv attend une virgule (,) entre les colonnes, alors que le fichier utilise un point-virgule (;). Toutes les colonnes sont donc collées en une seule

read.csv2  ne saute pas la première ligne de titre et ne reconnaît pas "n/a" comme une valeur manquante

Il manque uniquement le réglage de l'encodage (Latin1 au lieu de UTF-8) pour afficher correctement les accents français

```{r}
prix_fr <- read_csv2(
  "data/prix_fr.csv",
  skip = 1,
  na = c("n/a", "NA", "", "-"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1")
)
prix_fr
```

## Partie B : Excel, SAS et export

## B1. Un classeur à plusieurs feuilles

```{r}
# A
feuilles <- excel_sheets("data/pluie_mensuelle.xlsx")
feuilles

# B
pluie <- map_dfr(feuilles, ~ {
  read_excel("data/pluie_mensuelle.xlsx", sheet = .x, skip = 2) %>%
    mutate(annee = as.numeric(.x))
})

# C
cumul_annuel <- pluie %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = janv:déc, names_to = "mois", values_to = "mm") %>%
  group_by(station, annee) %>%
  summarise(cumul_annuel_mm = sum(mm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cumul_annuel
```

## B2. Des données SAS

```{r}
library(haven)
# A
pays <- read_sas("data/paysniv3.sas7bdat")

dim(pays)
colSums(is.na(pays))

# B
pays$CONTI <- factor(pays$CONTI, labels = c("Afrique", "Asie", "Amériques", "Europe", "Océanie"))

# C
stats_continent <- pays %>%
  group_by(CONTI) %>%
  summarise(
    nb_pays = n(),
    esperance_vie_moy = mean(ESPER, na.rm = TRUE),
    fecondite_moy = mean(FERTI, na.rm = TRUE),
    pnb_median = median(PNB, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(esperance_vie_moy))

stats_continent

# D
top5_min_esper <- pays %>%
  slice_min(ESPER, n = 5) %>%
  select(NOM, CONTI, ESPER)

top5_min_esper
```

## B3. Exporter

```{r}
library(writexl)
# A
write_csv2(bilan_meteo, "sorties/bilan_meteo.csv")

bilan_meteo_reluft <- read_csv2("sorties/bilan_meteo.csv")

# B
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Pluie_Mensuelle" = pluie,
    "Bilan_Meteo" = bilan_meteo
  ),
  path = "sorties/export_complet.xlsx"
)

# C
saveRDS(pays, "sorties/pays.rds")
pays_rds <- readRDS("sorties/pays.rds")

is.factor(pays_rds$CONTI)
```

## Partie C : Ranger les données (tidy data)

## C1. La pluie au format long

```{r}
# A
pluie_long <- pluie %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = janv:déc,
    names_to = "mois",
    values_to = "mm"
  )

# B
pluie_long <- pluie_long %>%
  mutate(
    mois = factor(
      mois, 
      levels = c("jan", "fév", "mar", "avr", "mai", "juin", "juil", "août", "sep", "oct", "nov", "déc"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# C
mois_plus_pluvieux_2025 <- pluie_long %>%
  filter(annee == 2025) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  slice_max(mm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(station, annee, mois, mm)

knitr::kable(mois_plus_pluvieux_2025, caption = "Mois le plus pluvieux par station en 2025")

# D
pluie_pivot <- pluie_long %>%
  group_by(station, annee, mois) %>%
  summarise(mm = sum(mm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annee,
    values_from = mm,
    names_prefix = "annee_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = annee_2025 - annee_2024
  )

forte_hausse <- pluie_pivot %>%
  slice_max(difference, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

head(pluie_pivot, 12)
```

## C2. Les températures au format long

```{r}

meteo_long <- meteo %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temp_min, temp_max),
    names_to = "type_mesure",
    values_to = "temperature",
    names_prefix = "temp_"
  )

amplitude_station <- meteo_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type_mesure,
    values_from = temperature
  ) %>%
  mutate(amplitude = max - min) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(
    amplitude_thermique_moyenne = mean(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

amplitude_station
```

## C3. Les vins

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# A
wines <- read_excel("data/wines.xlsx")

wines_long <- wines %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(rest|view|shaking|tasting)"),
    names_to = c("etape", "descripteur"),
    names_pattern = "^(rest|view|shaking|tasting)(.*)$",
    values_to = "note"
  )

# B
wines_moy_etape <- wines_long %>%
  group_by(Wines, etape) %>%
  summarise(note_moyenne = mean(note, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(etape = factor(etape, levels = c("rest", "view", "shaking", "tasting"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = etape,
    values_from = note_moyenne
  )

head(wines_moy_etape)

# C
top3_tasting <- wines_moy_etape %>%
  arrange(desc(tasting)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  left_join(wines %>% select(Wines, Soul), by = "Wines") %>%
  select(Wines, Soul, tasting)

top3_tasting

# D
correlation_global_tasting <- wines_moy_etape %>%
  left_join(wines %>% select(Wines, Global), by = "Wines") %>%
  summarise(correlation = cor(Global, tasting, use = "complete.obs"))

print(correlation_global_tasting)
```
